name: How long does window sash repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does window sash repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window sash repair varies depending on the extent of the damage, the type of window, and the number of sashes needing attention. Minor repairs, such as replacing a sash cord or a single pane of glass, might take a few hours per sash. More extensive repairs, like rebuilding a severely rotted wooden sash or restoring multiple historical sashes, could take several days or even longer, often requiring off-site work. A professional assessment will provide a more accurate timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage severity; minor fixes can take hours, while extensive or multiple sash repairs may require several days.
